Name: Bilal Mohamed
Company Short Description: Company River West Properties with 245 properties for rent and 133 properties for sale
Company Long Description:
River West Properties operates in the Kingdom of Bahrain since 2002 with hundreds of satisfied clients up to date.

We operate in all segments of the real estate market, from residential, offices, retail and leisure. The real estate development and investment division has a value-driven, asset enhancing, creative viewpoint. Our portfolio consists both of small-scale and large-scale area developments, ranging far and wide from residential to commercial properties.

Be it for rentals or purchase, we can offer a wide range of properties all over Bahrain. 

Whether you need a villa in compound near the causeway or on the gulf course, an apartment with direct sea view at 5 minutes from the airport we have them all!  We also undertake your request for office space and commercial.

Fully furnished, semi-furnished, unfurnished, in compound or stand alone.

We take pride into providing a fair advice on properties and customer satisfaction is our rule n.1. We will be of help for whatever paperwork you need to process. 

Take the opportunity of exceptional rates on the market to invest for your future! We have fully furnished apartments ready with ownership for expatriates and residence visa for the family.

Our clients range from individuals to corporate, embassies, military etc.

Our Services
•	Property sales
•	Rental of residential and commercial property experience in property brokerage.
•	Property management.

Our goal is to provide the very best in service and professional advice to both landlords and tenants alike, so whether you are looking to rent or let a property in Bahrain, River West Property is here to help.

Name: Mohamed Salamah
Company Short Description: Company Best Location Properties with 183 properties for rent and 440 properties for sale
Company Long Description:
Best Location a company in the Kingdom of Bahrain providing real estate solutions for every category in the property market including brokerage, valuation, and management. Best Location decided to enter into the real estate market to take advantage of the demand in the market. Our Team consists of professionals with diverse experience in different fields including property valuation, architecture, and engineering. Our clientele list includes some of the leading developers and individuals in the kingdom of Bahrain. 

The company has been thriving since its incorporation and has been increasing its clientele list. Recently it moved to office in the Seef district to take advantage of the location. Our vision is to grow and reflect that growth to our clients by guiding them and managing there assets. 

Best Location offers a turnkey solution when it comes to purchasing a property or short & long term leasing. Our team of professionals have an abundance of expertise within the local property market which ensures our customers receive the highest level of service. We use our extensive network and a variety of different mediums to generate as much exposure possible for any property we undertake.

 Our sales and leasing team are experienced and proficient in the sale and leasing of most property types from residential homes to commercial towers and buildings.

We at Best Location offer a comprehensive property and facility management service to ensure a stress free and reliable management of your asset.

Our Services include:

•Rent & Service Charge Collection

Name: Arun Kumar Mammaniya
Company Short Description: Company Pegasus Real Estate with 407 properties for rent and 148 properties for sale
Company Long Description:
Gain a new perspective…

 

Pegasus Real Estate a RERA registered property-management and brokerage agency, has been offering dedicated property management and real estate services since 2005. Currently representing a profile of properties worth over $250 million (marketed, managed & let), Pegasus continues to bring under its wing projects that can provide long-term gains to its clientele and owners.

 

Exclusively representing successfully now completed projects as Abraj Al Lulu (Pearl Towers), Platinum Tower, Juffair Skyview, Juffair Heights, Hamala Villas, Seef Terraces and others, Pegasus has delivered to its promise of converting buyers dreams to actual reality where they can now inhabit and enjoy various property offerings. Among its exclusively represented projects (managed/sales/lease) is the completed “Juffair Heights” project, a twin tower freehold residential project in Juffair and the luxury residential project, “Seef Terraces” completed in 2019 in the Seef area. The project was awarded with two Highly Commended awards by Arabian Property Awards a faction of the International Property Awards for “Best Residential High-Rise Development” and “Best Residential Development” for its apartment designs.

Pegasus was awarded the five-star award for “Best property consultancy marketing” for one of its exclusively represented projects in 2017 & 2018.

Some of the exclusive services provided by Pegasus include:

- Exclusive Representation                                                        - Development consultancy

- Property management                                                             - Brokerage (sale/lease)

- International sales                                                                    - Retail Management

- Facility management                                                                - Interior consultancy

- Finance/mortgage consultancy & approval                        - Letting & Relocation    

- Portfolio Management.                                                            - Interior fit-out & Furniture supply

 

Currently the agency boasts a team of 12 consultants across its sales, leasing and property management division. The sales & leasing team at Pegasus are well equipped & experienced in providing the required services towards sourcing, leasing and managing property as desired by a prospective buyer, owner, investor or tenant.

Covering the most prominent areas in Bahrain, the agencies property management, sales & leasing team sources the best possible options based on the tenants/client’s requirement.

Pegasus Realty is a part of the multi-diversified Business Group based in Bahrain with arms reaching from the trading sector to Construction, Travel, Hospitality and Hotel sectors. Being property developers as well, Pegasus understands the level of commitment and dedication required in delivering the project from initiation to completion.

Pegasus has managed to achieve a strong level of loyalty with its clientele and is a well-recognized brand within the real estate sector. Continually striving to achieve beneficial associations with property developers &owners, Pegasus is strongly commitment to servicing the Bahrain Market and provide up-to-date information on quality property developments to its clientele and prospective investors.

For detailed information on Pegasus and its offerings log onto www.pegasusbahrain.com
